## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated, `dotnet test` is green
- [ ] `dotnet format --verify-no-changes` is green
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under `[Unreleased]` (or label `skip-changelog` for internal changes)
- [ ] License headers present on new files
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`, DCO) and follow Conventional Commits
- [ ] Documentation updated if behavior is user-visible
